bug_semantics: GitPython clone APIs (Repo.clone, Repo.clone_from, and submodule clone) forward caller-controlled git-clone options after checking them against Repo.unsafe_git_clone_options. Through 3.1.53 that denylist was only --upload-pack/-u and --config/-c, omitting --template. Under the default allow_unsafe_options=False, Git._option_candidates turns template='<dir>' into --template and check_unsafe_options lets it through; git clone --template=<dir> then copies <dir>/hooks into the new repository and runs post-checkout during checkout, yielding arbitrary command execution. Independent of short-option value-smuggling; --template is a legitimate long option. CWE-184/CWE-78.
